newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Den Danske Bank says has 81.1 percent of Ostgota.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske Bank says has 81.1 percent of Ostgota.

text.p: Denmark's Den Danske Bank said on Tuesday that it now had control of 81.1 percent of the share capital and votes of provincial Swedish bank, Ostgota Enskilda Bank.
The Danish bank bought a 77 percent slice of the bank on Monday from Swedish property and finance group Lundbergs for 50.50 crowns a share and said it was bidding for the rest of the bank.
"We have bought 2,213,000 shares in Ostgota Enskilda Bank," Den Danske Bank said in a statement.
"Den Danske Bank group therefore owns a total of 45,704,645 shares in Ostgota Enskilda Bank which represents 81.1 percent of the company's share capital and votes."
Ostgota Enskilda Bank is based in Linkoping and has 29 branches and about 550 employees.
